TC-20/S16.title: Double tap on the In Today toggle: the toggle ends where two taps put it, and the dashboard agrees
TC-20/S16.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts + agent unit U56. Judged 1/4. Known B30, still on dev. A double-click on Hal's 'In Today ✓' loses one tap: the toggle ends on '+ Today', the stored inTodaysSession is false, and the dashboard no longer lists Hal. Toggle, server and dashboard agree with each other (the dashboard is not stale; the tap is lost in the list's toggle). Agent unit U56 (oracle.mjs, one browser_click with doubleClick: true) on the same build: Fail, the same lost tap ('+ Today', inTodaysSession false, dashboard Total 0, 'No residents on today's visit list.').
TC-20/S16.productIssue: A physician who double-taps 'In Today ✓' sees the resident drop off Today's Visits and the dashboard (one tap lost).
